richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sikkim

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to towns across Sikkim, including Gangtok, Namchi and the smaller hill settlements. Our Fun Fitness machines are built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and come into Sikkim by road through Siliguri. Our installation team or a dealer in the region fixes them on your site, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

Buyers in Sikkim include schools, colleges, government departments, town authorities and the hotels and resorts that serve the state's visitors. A hotel can add a few stations on a lawn or terrace so guests can exercise with a mountain view. A school or a town park usually needs a larger set. Tell us the space and who will use it, and we will suggest a layout. We mark the clear area for each machine, which matters on narrow terraces with a drop on one side. Schools in Namchi and Gangtok often place the gym next to the assembly ground so it can double as a sports area.

Sikkim's monsoon is heavy and long, and landslides can close roads for days. We plan dispatch with you so the equipment reaches your town when the roads are open. Winters are cold in Gangtok and much colder in the north. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle both rain and cold, and grouting keeps stations firm on terraced ground. Pick a spot that gets morning sun, since shaded slopes stay damp and cold well into the day.

items.q: Can a hotel in Sikkim add a small outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Three or four low-impact stations on a lawn or terrace are enough for guests. Share photos and measurements and we will suggest machines and mark the clear space on a drawing.

items.q: Will the equipment cope with Sikkim's cold winters?
items.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof in rain and cold. Keep moving parts clear of ice and debris and check bearings at the start of each season.

items.q: How is equipment delivered to Sikkim?
items.a: We dispatch by road from our Vasai factory, and the truck enters Sikkim through Siliguri. We confirm timing with you, since monsoon landslides can close hill roads.
